title: AI Engineering Lab: Synthetic Data & Fine-Tuned Specialist Fleet
description: 10 GitHub repositories to turn frontier models into an AI engineering lab generating data, fine-tuning specialists, and benchmarking performance.
philosophy: One powerful model helping build an entire fleet of specialists. You don't need your most powerful model answering every question.
architecture_pipeline: frontier model -> generate data -> curate -> fine tune -> benchmark -> compare -> deploy -> collect feedback -> repeat
